'''Alfalfa''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can be planted in all seasons, the leaves are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]], and the seeds when cooked.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] alfalfa for its ''sprouts''.
